messages:
maria-cs: Flagging a customer-impacting issue: onboarding delays for tenants created during the EU index migration last night. ~15 tenants affected (mostly trials, 3 high-touch). Need comms (+ localized), credit offer, and a 1:1 scheduling link for high-touch.

sam-eng: Investigating now. Early root cause: indexer backlog + provisioning retries that amplified load and hit an internal rate limiter. Spun up extra indexers and relaxed retry policy; queue depth falling. ETA for catch-up ~30-45m.

ashley-se: Can you paste a short RCA we can include and a bullet list of mitigation steps? Also DM tenant list so we can draft individual notes for the 3 high-touch accounts.

sam-eng: RCA blurb (copyable): "During an EU index migration we observed a processing backlog that, combined with aggressive provisioning retries, triggered a rate-limiter on onboarding traffic. Engineers increased indexing capacity, adjusted retry backoff, and temporarily widened the limiter window to clear the backlog."

neil-ops: Rolled limiter config at 17:18 UTC. Backfill status: 10/15 tenants completed, 5 actively catching up. Monitoring alerts are green. :white_check_mark:

maria-cs: Draft outbound (short):

Hi <Customer name>,

We experienced a provisioning delay for customers onboarded during a recent EU platform migration. Our engineers have implemented a fix and are backfilling affected tenants. Your tenant should be available shortly.

What we did: increased indexing capacity, tuned provisioning retries, and monitored backfill until completion.
Offer: 1 week of platform credits for trials, 2 weeks for high-touch accounts, plus an optional 1:1 office-hours slot. Reply to this message if you need a prioritized import.

We apologize for the disruption. We'll send a short post-incident summary and a quick feedback form.

sam-eng: quick log sample for RCA: `2026-03-23T17:12:09Z provisioning.worker INFO attempt=7 tenant=tenant-441 err="rate_limited: provisioning_window"`

lina-localization: I can localize FR/DE/ES. Send final subject + body and I'll return translated copies within 20m with region-specific office-hour CTAs.

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 created: "EU migration onboarding delay" Severity=S2 Owners=sam-eng,neil-ops,maria-cs

maria-cs: Plan: send individualized notes to the 3 high-touch accounts within 45m; send localized bulk note to trials after Lina posts translations. Post a status update here in 30m and a customer-facing RCA in ~24h.
